Pound Sign Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Pound Sign is 156. Hold Alt, type 156 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Pound Sign also has the Unicode codepoint U+00A3, so you can type it with Alt+163 on Windows, search for U+00A3 in macOS's Character Viewer, use £ in HTML, or \00A3 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥3 for Pound Sign; shortcuts can differ on other layouts. HTML also defines the named entity £ for Pound Sign, but the numeric form £ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type pound sign on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 5 6 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Pound Sign character (£) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type pound sign on macOS

On a US keyboard layout, press ⌥3 to insert Pound Sign. This shortcut assumes a US layout; other layouts may remap it.

If the shortcut does not work on your layout, open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Pound Sign" and click the character.

How to use pound sign in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00A3"; ()
  • Python: \u00A3 or chr(0xA3)
  • JavaScript: \u00A3 or String.fromCodePoint(0xA3)
  • JSON: "\u00A3"
  • LaTeX: $\pounds$ (text mode)

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Pound Sign?

The legacy Alt code for Pound Sign is 156. Hold Alt, type 1 5 6 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type £ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as £, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+163 not work?

Alt+163 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Pound Sign?

The Unicode codepoint for Pound Sign is U+00A3. You can use this value in HTML as £, in CSS as \00A3, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type £ on a Mac?

On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥3. If that does not work on your layout, open ⌃⌘Space and search for U+00A3.
